positions.as_written: Place the probe over the structure to be tested and apply the stress it resists.
Compare with the other side under the same stress, which is the only available reference.
Ask the patient whether the manoeuvre reproduces their symptom, and record the answer.
Record a clip rather than a still, because the finding is a change over time.
